title: Root transitions preserve the forward unit--Chern projective square
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, n a natural number, and A the finite coefficient quotient at level n+1. Let S be Noetherian with l invertible. For r≤s with both l^(r+1) and l^(s+1) killing A, use the fixed root-power transition e on the shifted lines of [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates]. For the actual ordinary projective decompositions b_r,b_s, one has b_s.hom followed by Rq_*(e) = (e on S ⊕ identity) followed by b_r.hom. There also exist pro-etale decomposition isomorphisms whose homs are exactly the prescribed supported projectiveB arrows at r and s, satisfying the identical forward square after comparison. This asserts only the forward decomposition squares in the coordinates of [def-pur-integration-exponent-transport-data]; no inverse-trace or affine-tower equation is included.

proof.text: The root-power Kummer sequence square preserves the supported infinity class; apply finite Tate descent to identify its coefficient with the prescribed transition. Naturality of the adjunction unit gives the other component square. The biproduct universal property proves the pro-etale forward square.

Use projectiveB_isIso for the actual pro-etale decompositions. The fixed proper mate and p1KummerTraceSiteTransport carry each ordinary component to the preceding pro-etale component. Naturality of the mate and full faithfulness on bounded shifted lines reflect the ordinary forward square.

theorem integrationProjectiveExponentSquare (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (r s : ℕ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (hs : ((l ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) :
  IntegrationDecompositionSquare
    (integrationLineTransition l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs).hom
    ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePushforward _ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map
      (integrationLineTransition l E n (ProjectiveLine S)
        (by simpa using hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom) r s hrs hr hs).hom)
    (kummerTraceOrdinaryDatum l E n S hS r hr).decomposition
    (kummerTraceOrdinaryDatum l E n S hS s hs).decomposition ∧
  ∃ (br : (line l E n r hr S ⊞ unit (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n))
        (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).rightDerivedFunctor.obj (line l E n r hr (ProjectiveLine S)))
    (bs : (line l E n s hs S ⊞ unit (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n))
        (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).rightDerivedFunctor.obj (line l E n s hs (ProjectiveLine S))),
    br.hom = projectiveB l E n S hS (infinityCartier S) r hr ∧
    bs.hom = projectiveB l E n S hS (infinityCartier S) s hs ∧
    IntegrationDecompositionSquare
      ((comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S).map
        (integrationLineTransition l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs).hom)
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n))
        (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) (ProjectiveLine S)).map
            (integrationLineTransition l E n (ProjectiveLine S)
              (by simpa using hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom)
              r s hrs hr hs).hom)) br bs
